thread:
alex: Heads-up – started a quick audit after the dashboards showed a 20% jump in cost-per-token for /chat/generate this morning.
priya: saw that too. Is it latency or token accounting growth? quick glance showed latency p50 up ~12ms.
alex: p50 +12ms, p95 +40ms. But billing units (server-side token_count) reported ~1.03x tokens compared to client. Could be KV cache misses or a new kernel path.
mateo: I pulled a few request traces. Kernel selector flipped to the "f32_compat" path for a set of model variants at ~03:10 UTC.
jun: that selector flip would impact perf but not token counts. KV misses would increase compute though.
alex: logs attached from runtime:
```
2026-03-16T03:09:58Z INFO kernel_selector: chosen=f32_compat reason=quant_hint_mismatch seq_len=512
2026-03-16T03:10:01Z WARN kv_cache: miss_rate=0.28 route=/chat/generate model=redwood-v1
2026-03-16T03:10:05Z INFO batching: mean_batch_ms=18.2 fallback=false
```
priya: miss_rate 28% is high for that route — usually <5% for steady traffic.
mateo: checked rollout flags: there was a gradual quant-profile promotion yesterday that increased allowed quant variants. Could be correlated.
alex: We need two fronts: 1) instrumentation to attribute cost-per-token to kernel path + KV cache hit/miss; 2) dashboard panel for per-route unit economics (tokens * kernel_cost + kv_penalty).
jun: agree. Current dashboards show per-route tokens and latency, but not kernel path distribution. We should add a breakdown: count by kernel_selector.chosen and kv_cache.hit boolean.
priya: for quick triage, a PromQL sketch:
```
sum by(route, chosen) (rate(runtime_kernel_ms_sum[5m])) / sum by(route) (rate(runtime_kernel_calls[5m]))
```
that gives avg kernel latency by chosen path per route.
mateo: and KV hit ratio:
```
sum by(route) (increase(kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum by(route) (increase(kv_cache_requests[5m]))
```
alex: For cost accounting, billing-bot currently marks billed_tokens from edge. We need to align billed_tokens to runtime_token_events and tag kernel path so we can compute effective cost-per-billed-token given kernel CPU/GPU ms.
billing-bot: FYI I can emit a billing-alignment event: billed_tokens -> runtime_token_id mapping with route tag if runtime includes runtime_token_id in the call. We'll need a small change in the SDK to forward runtime_token_id (opaque).
jun: low-risk change. Alternatively, we can compute a sampled join: sample 0.5% of requests with token_id and use that to extrapolate.
priya: Sampling is faster to deploy. For the dashboard we can show sampled-corroboration and a note about confidence interval.
alex: Action items:
- priya: add Prometheus panels for kernel_selector.chosen distribution and kv_cache hit ratio by route (ETA: today end of day).
- mateo: run a 1-hour sample join between billed_tokens and runtime_token_events, push results to billing-scratch (ETA: 3 hours).
- jun: open SDK tiny change ticket to forward runtime_token_id (PR if we need exact joins) (ETA: EOD).
- infra-bot: flag any other kernel path flips in the last 24h and link deploy IDs.
infra-bot: TODO logged: infra#4821: emit kernel_selector flip events -> #ops-incidents, scanned deploys 2026-03-15..2026-03-16, flagged deploy dpl-4287 as likely cause.
mateo: quick note — if kernel path is slower but cheaper (quantized fallback) our cost-per-token calculation should include kernel_cost = gpu_ms * per_gpu_ms_cost + fallback_cpu_ms * per_cpu_ms_cost.
alex: exactly. Our "unit economics" panel should be configurable by cost model params (gpu_ms_rate, cpu_ms_rate) so finance can tweak.
priya: I'll prototype a Grafana derived series: kernel_ms_by_route * rate_gpu + (1 - kv_hit) * kv_penalty_ms * rate_cpu then divide by billed_tokens. We can show a delta vs prior-week.
alex: If the sample join shows billed_tokens inflation vs client tokens, we should create a billing-adjustments doc for sales. Not yet — we need to be sure.
jun: Can we revert the quant-profile promotion temporarily? If dpl-4287 is the one, we can rollback to previous profile for the affected model and watch.
mateo: I'll coordinate with model-onboarding to pin the variant for the next 30m if we confirm.
alex: OK plan: immediate sampling + dashboard panels. We'll regroup in 2 hours. Thanks all.
priya: adding a lightweight dashboard note: "sampling CI: 95%" and a link to the sample join table.
alex: pinging @billing-bot for any chargebacks watchlist.
billing-bot: Added watchlist entry for account-tier=enterprise routes for the next 24h.
jun: thanks — will report back with sample results.
